extracted.PURPOSE: Staleness re-test of the two claims most likely to have been superseded between the prior sweep and now: whether the 503B bulks exclusion went final, and whether the Fifth Circuit ruled.

BULKS_EXCLUSION_STILL_PROPOSED_PRIOR_REP.finding: No final determination located as of 2026-07-30. Index continues to describe the April 30, 2026 action as a proposal, with comments due June 29, 2026, and states FDA will consider comments before making a final determination.
BULKS_EXCLUSION_STILL_PROPOSED_PRIOR_REP.verdict: The prior report's insistence that the site MUST NOT state the exclusion is finalized is CORRECT and survives. This is the prior report's strongest and best-calibrated call.
BULKS_EXCLUSION_STILL_PROPOSED_PRIOR_REP.caveat: Absence of a located final determination is absence of evidence from an index behind a total egress blockade. It is not a verified negative. A final determination could have issued and not been indexed.

FIFTH_CIRCUIT_STILL_UNDECIDED_PRIOR_REPO.finding: No ruling located, four months after the March 25, 2026 argument. Index states no decision has been issued on the appeal.
FIFTH_CIRCUIT_STILL_UNDECIDED_PRIOR_REPO.verdict: The prior report's STATUS_VOLATILE rule and its instruction that the site must not assert compounded GLP-1s are 'illegal' as a settled matter both survive.
FIFTH_CIRCUIT_STILL_UNDECIDED_PRIOR_REPO.status: UNVERIFIED - zero court documents read; courtlistener.com and both brief PDFs are 403.

MINOR_OVERSTATEMENT_DOCKET_MAPPING.prior_report_claim: Mapping of Fifth Circuit dockets 25-10600 and 25-10758 to the tirzepatide case (4:24-cv-00953-P) versus the semaglutide case (4:25-cv-00174) was 'NOT ESTABLISHED'.
MINOR_OVERSTATEMENT_DOCKET_MAPPING.what_is_locatable: A brief PDF titled 'No. 25-10758 IN THE UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS FOR THE FIFTH CIRCUIT' is filed under the slug ofa-vs-fda-novo-nordisk-brief.pdf. Novo Nordisk is the semaglutide intervenor, which points to 25-10758 being the semaglutide appeal. The companion PDF is titled 'No. 25-10600' under slug ofa-vs-fda-appellees-brief.pdf.
MINOR_OVERSTATEMENT_DOCKET_MAPPING.assessment: This is a secondary-source inference from a filename and a cover page, hosted on a press site that is itself 403. It LOCATES the mapping; it cannot CONFIRM it. The prior report's 'not established' is therefore defensible, merely slightly over-pessimistic. Minor severity. No downstream effect - the mapping is irrelevant to the exclusion outcome.
